name: Barbell bench press
setup: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar, feet flat, and squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
cues: Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it over your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades together and keep your chest tall.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your ribs.
Touch your chest lightly, then push the floor away until your elbows lock.
Keep your glutes on the bench the whole time.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
breathing: Inhale on the way down, brace, exhale as you press up.
safetyNotes: Use safety pins or a spotter when working near failure.

name: Dumbbell bench press
setup: Sit on the bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then kick them back as you lie down.
cues: Plant your feet and set your shoulder blades back and down.
Hold the dumbbells over your chest with a slight inward tilt.
Lower until your upper arms are level with your torso.
Press up and slightly together without clanging the dumbbells.
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift toward the head

name: Incline dumbbell press
setup: Set the bench to about 30 degrees — steeper turns it into a shoulder press.
cues: Sit back with the dumbbells over your upper chest.
Keep your ribs down and lower to a comfortable stretch.
Press up and slightly back over the collarbone.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad
Pressing straight up instead of over the upper chest

name: Machine chest press
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest height.
cues: Sit tall with your shoulders back against the pad.
Press until your elbows are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
breathing: Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.

name: Push-up
setup: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in one line from head to heels.
cues: Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lower your chest until it is a fist from the floor.
Push the floor away, keeping your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Elevate your hands on a bench to make it easier, elevate your feet to make it harder.

name: Cable chest fly
setup: Set both pulleys at chest height and take a staggered stance.
cues: Keep a soft bend in the elbows for the whole set.
Bring your hands together in front of your sternum.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch, never past your shoulders.
breathing: Exhale as you bring the hands together.

name: Parallel bar dip
setup: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms, shoulders pulled down.
cues: Lean forward slightly for chest emphasis.
Lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders to your ears.
safetyNotes: Skip if you feel any pinching at the front of the shoulder.

name: Barbell overhead press
setup: Bar on your front delts, hands just outside shoulder width, feet hip width.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Press the bar up past your chin, moving your head back slightly.
Lock out with the bar over your ears, then return to the collarbone.
mistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press
Pressing around the chin instead of back
breathing: Inhale before the rep, exhale at the top.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
setup: Sit on an upright bench with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
cues: Brace your core and keep your back against the pad.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly in.
Lower until your elbows are just below shoulder level.
mistakes: Pressing in front of the body

name: Machine shoulder press
setup: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
cues: Sit tall, shoulders back.
Press up without locking out aggressively.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Pike push-up
setup: From a push-up position, walk your feet in and lift your hips into an upside-down V.
cues: Keep your hips high and your head between your hands.
Lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up and keep the hips stacked.

name: Band overhead press
setup: Stand on the middle of the band, handles at shoulder height.
cues: Brace your abs so you don't lean back.
Press overhead until the arms are straight.
Resist the band on the way down.
mistakes: Letting the elbows flare behind the body

name: Barbell row
setup: Hinge until your torso is about 45 degrees, bar hanging under your shoulders.
cues: Brace your torso and keep a neutral spine.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then lower under control.
mistakes: Jerking the bar with the lower back

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
setup: One hand and knee on the bench, the other foot on the floor, back flat.
cues: Let the dumbbell hang under your shoulder.
Row toward your hip, not your armpit.
Lower until you feel the lat stretch.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulder to your ear

name: Seated cable row
setup: Feet on the platform, knees soft, torso upright.
cues: Reach forward without rounding your lower back.
Pull the handle to your navel and squeeze.
Return slowly, letting the shoulder blades open.
mistakes: Leaning back and forth to move the weight

name: Inverted row
setup: Set a bar at hip height, lie underneath it and grip shoulder width.
cues: Keep your body in one straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, elbows to your sides.
Lower until your arms are straight.

name: Band seated row
setup: Loop the band around your feet and sit tall.
cues: Sit with a neutral spine and slight knee bend.
Pull the band to your waist, elbows back.
Control the return until the arms are straight.

name: Chest-supported machine row
setup: Chest against the pad, feet planted.
cues: Let the arms extend fully with the shoulder blades forward.
Pull the handles back and squeeze.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad

name: Pull-up
setup: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
cues: Start from a full hang with active shoulders.
Pull your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to a straight-arm hang.
safetyNotes: Use a band or negatives until you can do 5 clean reps.

name: Lat pulldown
setup: Thigh pad snug, hands just outside shoulder width.
cues: Sit tall and lean back only about 10 degrees.
Pull the bar to your collarbone, elbows down.
Let the bar rise until the arms are straight.

name: Band lat pulldown
setup: Anchor the band high above you and kneel or sit.
cues: Keep your ribs down and chest tall.
Pull your elbows down toward your hips.
Return slowly against the band tension.

name: Negative pull-up
setup: Jump or step up so your chin is over the bar.
cues: Start at the top with your chin above the bar.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can — aim for 4 seconds.
Step down and reset instead of dropping.
mistakes: Starting from a dead hang without control
breathing: Breathe steadily; this is a slow eccentric.
safetyNotes: Perfect stepping stone toward your first pull-up.

name: Barbell back squat
setup: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
cues: Take a breath and brace before you move.
Sit down and back, knees tracking over the toes.
Descend until your hip crease passes your knee, or as deep as you can control.
Drive through the whole foot to stand.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom
breathing: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand.
safetyNotes: Use a rack with safety pins; this is a technical lift.

name: Goblet squat
setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest.
cues: Keep the dumbbell tight to your sternum.
Sit straight down with your elbows inside your knees.
Stand up and squeeze your glutes at the top.

name: Leg press
setup: Feet shoulder width on the platform, back and hips flat against the pad.
cues: Lower until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep the knees tracking over the toes.
Press without locking the knees aggressively.
mistakes: Letting the lower back round off the pad

name: Bodyweight squat
setup: Feet shoulder width, arms out in front for balance.
cues: Sit back and down with your chest tall.
Go as deep as your ankles allow.
Stand up and finish with the glutes.

name: Barbell deadlift
setup: Bar over your mid-foot, shins close, hands just outside your knees.
cues: Take the slack out of the bar before you pull.
Push the floor away and keep the bar against your legs.
Stand tall with your hips and shoulders rising together.
Hinge back down, bar tracking over the mid-foot.
breathing: Inhale and brace hard, exhale after lockout.
safetyNotes: Learn this with light weight or a coach first.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
setup: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip width, knees soft.
cues: Push your hips back and keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch or your back wants to round.
Stand by driving your hips forward.
mistakes: Rounding the back to go lower
breathing: Inhale down, exhale as you stand.

name: Glute bridge
setup: Lie on your back, heels close to your glutes.
cues: Tuck your pelvis slightly and press through your heels.
Lift until your hips, knees and shoulders form a line.
Squeeze the glutes for a second at the top.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of using the glutes

name: Cable pull-through
setup: Face away from a low pulley, rope between your legs.
cues: Hinge with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings load.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top without leaning back.

name: Kettlebell swing
setup: Kettlebell on the floor a foot in front of you, feet shoulder width.
cues: Hike the bell back between your legs like a snap.
Stand up fast and let the bell float to chest height.
Let it fall back into the next hinge.
breathing: Sharp exhale at the top of each swing.

name: Single-leg hip thrust
setup: Lie on your back with one foot planted, the other leg extended.
cues: Keep the pelvis level as you press up.
Drive through the planted heel.
Lower slowly without letting the hip drop.
mistakes: Using the lower back to lift

name: Walking lunge
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, stand tall.
cues: Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to step through.
Keep the torso upright the whole time.
breathing: Breathe steadily; exhale as you step up.

name: Reverse lunge
setup: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
cues: Step back and lower with control.
Keep the front shin close to vertical.
Push through the front foot to return.
mistakes: Stepping too narrow and losing balance
breathing: Inhale as you step back, exhale as you return.

name: Bulgarian split squat
setup: Rear foot on a bench, front foot about two feet forward.
cues: Let the back knee travel down toward the floor.
Keep most of the weight on the front leg.
Stand up without pushing off the back toes.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench
Losing balance from a narrow stance

name: Barbell split squat
setup: Bar on your back, staggered stance.
cues: Keep the torso vertical and the pelvis square.
Lower straight down, back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
mistakes: Front knee travelling too far forward
safetyNotes: Use a rack for balance while learning the pattern.

name: Lying leg curl
setup: Pad on the back of your ankles, hips down on the bench.
cues: Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep the hips pressing into the pad.
Lower slowly, resisting to the end.

name: Leg extension
setup: Set the pad on your shins, knees in line with the pivot.
cues: Extend the knees smoothly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control to about 90 degrees.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat

name: Banded hamstring curl
setup: Anchor the band low in front of you and loop it around one ankle, lying face down.
cues: Keep the hips still as you curl your heel to your glute.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower slowly against the band.

name: Dumbbell step-up
setup: Box or bench at knee height, dumbbells at your sides.
cues: Place the whole front foot on the box.
Drive through the front leg to stand up.
Lower slowly to the floor.
mistakes: Using a box that is too high

name: Barbell curl
setup: Stand tall with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
cues: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl to chest height without swinging.
Lower fully to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell curl
setup: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
cues: Curl one arm at a time, elbow fixed.
Squeeze at the top, rotate the palm slightly up.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Cable curl
setup: Low pulley with a straight or EZ bar.
cues: Keep tension by stopping just short of straight arms.
Curl up with the elbows still.
Control the eccentric.

name: Band curl
setup: Stand on the band, handles in each hand.
cues: Keep the elbows at your sides.
Curl to chest height.
Resist on the way down.

name: Hammer curl
setup: Dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip.
cues: Keep the palms facing each other throughout.
Curl without moving the elbows.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable pushdown
setup: High pulley with a rope or bar, elbows at your sides.
cues: Keep the upper arms glued to your ribs.
Extend the elbows fully and squeeze.
Return until your forearms are just above parallel.

name: Overhead dumbbell extension
setup: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, elbows pointing forward.
cues: Keep the elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend to straight arms without flaring.

name: Bench dip
setup: Hands on the bench just behind your hips, feet forward.
cues: Keep your back close to the bench.
Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Press up without shrugging.
safetyNotes: Skip if you feel shoulder pinching.

name: Band pushdown
setup: Anchor the band high, grip both handles.
cues: Keep the elbows at your sides.
Extend and squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly.

name: Skull crusher
setup: Lie on a bench with the bar held over your chest, elbows narrow.
cues: Lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep the upper arms still.
Extend to straight arms.
safetyNotes: Use a spotter or light weight while learning.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
setup: Dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows.
cues: Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Raise to shoulder height only.
Lower slowly, staying in control.

name: Cable lateral raise
setup: Low pulley set behind you, handle in the far hand.
cues: Keep constant tension across the body.
Raise to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Band lateral raise
setup: Stand on the band, handles at your sides.
cues: Raise to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Keep the ribs down.
Lower slowly against tension.

name: Bent-over rear delt fly
setup: Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
cues: Let the dumbbells hang straight down.
Raise your arms out to the sides, leading with the pinkies.
Squeeze the rear delts, then lower.
mistakes: Using the lower back to lift

name: Standing calf raise
setup: Shoulder pads set, balls of feet on the platform.
cues: Drop your heels for a full stretch.
Press up onto the toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.

name: Dumbbell calf raise
setup: Hold dumbbells, balls of the feet on a step or plate.
cues: Sink the heels below the step.
Rise as high as possible.
Lower slowly to the stretch.

name: Single-leg calf raise
setup: Stand on one foot on a step, fingertips on a wall for balance.
cues: Lower the heel slowly.
Press up onto the ball of the foot.
Keep the knee almost straight.
mistakes: Using the arms to pull up

name: Front plank
setup: Forearms under your shoulders, feet hip width.
cues: Squeeze your glutes and brace as if bracing for a punch.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Breathe shallow but steady — do not hold your breath.
safetyNotes: Stop the set when your lower back starts to ache.

name: Dead bug
setup: Lie on your back, knees over hips, arms pointing at the ceiling.
cues: Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg without arching.
Return and switch sides.
mistakes: Lower back arching off the floor

name: Hanging leg raise
setup: Hang from a bar with active shoulders.
cues: Tilt your pelvis back before you lift.
Raise your legs to hip height or higher with control.
Lower slowly without swinging.
safetyNotes: Master the hanging knee raise first if this causes swinging.

name: Cable crunch
setup: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope beside your head.
cues: Crunch your ribs toward your pelvis.
Keep the hips still.
Return slowly to a stretch.

name: Side plank
setup: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
cues: Stack your feet and lift the hips.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Reach the top arm to the ceiling.
